product.name: Reinsurance Underwriting
product.description: Underwriting tailored reinsurance offerings to meet cedants’ risk tolerances, focusing on cyber and emerging risks.

product.description: Formulating scalable strategies for commercial and personal cyber insurance lines to help partners understand or enter the market.

product.name: Envelop Capital Markets
product.description: Creating access to cyber risk portfolios and diversifying investment portfolios through innovative risk-transfer solutions.

product.name: Envelop Risk Solutions
product.description: Providing custom analytics, threat intelligence, underwriting support, and platform development to enhance cyber insurance performance.

product.description: Monitoring and analyzing the cyber threat landscape to inform risk assessment and underwriting strategies.

product.description: A proprietary AI-driven risk estimation and capital management system forecasting cyber losses dynamically.
